livingCosts.notes: The university publishes no itemised cost-of-living estimate for Heidelberg, so this is DAAD's 'Average expenses of a German student' (national average, DZHW 22nd Social Survey 2023): rent incl. utilities EUR 410; food EUR 198; transportation EUR 89; personal = recreation/culture/sports 65 + clothing 46 + working materials 31 + telephone/internet/licence 32 + other 144 = EUR 318. Excludes health insurance (100), tuition (76) and semester contribution (36). DAAD is the German Academic Exchange Service, not the university, so marked secondary. Heidelberg's own page only gives a total of 'min. EUR 992 per month' (the residence-permit minimum) with no breakdown.

programmes.name: Computer Science (Informatik) B.Sc.
programmes.notes: Baden-Württemberg tuition fee for non-EU/EEA students with a foreign university entrance qualification: EUR 1,500 per semester x2 (in force since winter 2017/18; EU/EEA students and holders of a German entrance qualification are exempt). Compulsory fees = semester fee EUR 189.80 per semester x2 (administrative fee 80 + Studierendenwerk 95 + student body 10 + nextbike 2.30 + theatre flatrate 2.50), from https://www.uni-heidelberg.de/en/study/management-of-studies/semester-fees. Language of instruction: German, partly English. 2024/2025 history: the tuition page states the EUR 1,500 fee has applied since 2017/18; the semester fee of those years was not found, so history entries carry tuition only (current compulsory fees are used).
